crossRefs.note: One of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
including Ahijah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the priest of Yahweh in…
Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring God’s ark here.” For God’s ark was with the children of Israel at that time.
Saul said, “Let’s go down after the Philistines by night, and take plunder among them until the morning light, and…
Saul asked counsel of God, “Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will you deliver them into the hand of Israel?” But…
You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes…
“You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

people.name: Abiathar
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

people.name: Ahimelech
people.line: High Priest at Nob who helped David, killed by Saul

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Keilah
people.line: A town in the Shephelah of Judah, rescued by David

translations.web: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, he came down with an ephod in his hand.
translations.bsb: (Now Abiathar son of Ahimelech had brought the ephod with him when he fled to David at Keilah.)
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.
